title: Unique Substrings With Equal Digit Frequency
goal: Count distinct substrings whose present digits all occur equally often.
strategy: Extend each start position while updating ten digit counts. A substring qualifies when all nonzero counts agree; a set deduplicates equal text appearing at different positions.
